blocks.text: Free days to enjoy the activities and beaches of the Búzios peninsula: more than 20 magnificent beaches and crystal-clear water, set against exotic vegetation, with summer weather almost all year. In the 1960s, Búzios became a summer refuge for the people of Rio; after the actress Brigitte Bardot stayed there, the small fishing village gained an international reputation. Its traditional Rua das Pedras (Stone Street) is lined with bars, sophisticated restaurants, elegant shops and even a cinema named after the French actress.
